Create a workspace from a configuration or saved template. Returns `201` when created, `200` for an identical retry with the same ID, or `409` if that ID has a different configuration. Set `explain=true` to check policies without creating anything.
```json 201 Created { "id": "demo", "status": "running", "created_at": 1794009600, "system_time": null, "sessions": [ { "session_id": "01a1b425-ec80-7038-86e0-75b597344043", "cwd": "/" } ], "mounts": [ { "prefix": "/", "vfs": "ram", "mode": "write", "description": "", "backend": "workspace", "mountpoint": null } ], "internals": null } ```
| Status | Meaning | | --- | --- | | `401` | The token is missing or wrong | | `403` | A policy or mount mode refused the call | | `409` | The identifier already exists with a different workspace configuration. | | `422` | Validation Error | | `429` | Past a rate limit, or a new session past max_sessions | | `503` | The server is at max_workspaces, or shutting down | See [error examples and recovery steps](/api/errors). Run a shell command or script in the workspace and return its exit code and output. One endpoint serves three modes: | Mode | Request | Response | | --- | --- | --- | | Run (default) | no query flags | One JSON result when the command ends. | | Stream | `stream=true` | NDJSON output records as they are produced, then a status record. | | Explain | `explain=true` | The policy decision. Nothing runs. | A `200` means the request was accepted, not that the command succeeded. Check `exit_code`. A command refused by a policy also returns `200`, with a non-zero `exit_code` (usually `126`) and the reason in `refusal`. The request stays open until the command ends, and closing it cancels the command. To leave work running, end the command with `&`; it returns at once and the work appears under [jobs](/api/operations/jobs/list-jobs). Every result carries a `line_id` for the [lines](/api/operations/lines/get-command) endpoints. To send input, use a `multipart/form-data` body with a `stdin` part, or set `open_stdin=true` with `stream=true` to write while the command runs. See [Streaming and stdin](/api/streaming). ## Stream output Set `stream=true` to receive output as it is produced. Each line is one JSON record: output records carry base64 `data`, and the last record carries `status` and the final `result`. ```bash curl --no-buffer --request POST \ --url 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/shell?stream=true' \ --header 'Authorization: Bearer ' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{"command":"echo hello"}' ``` ```json {"stream":"stdout","data":"aGVsbG8K"} {"status":"done","result":{"exit_code":0,"stdout":"","stderr":"","refusal":null,"line_id":"line_019a5e2c-7b41-7c3e-9f20-4d8e1a6b5c37"},"error":null} ``` ## Explain a command Set `explain=true` to get the policy decision without running the command. The response has one `node` per part of the line; the example below is trimmed to one command. ```bash curl --request POST \ --url 'http://127.0.0.1:8765/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/shell?explain=true' \ --header 'Authorization: Bearer ' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{"command":"echo hello"}' ``` ```json { "line": "echo hello", "outcome": "allow", "reason": "", "refusal": null, "exit_code": 0, "node": { "type": "line", "text": "echo hello", "children": [ { "type": "command", "text": "echo hello", "command": "echo", "outcome": "allow", "children": [] } ] } } ``` ## Refused commands A command a policy refuses does not run. The response is still `200`, with exit code `126` and the reason in `refusal`. ```json { "exit_code": 126, "stdout": "", "stderr": "rm: Permission denied\n", "refusal": { "kind": "deny", "reason": "rm is not allowed in this workspace", "policy": "PermissionsPolicy", "ask_id": null }, "line_id": "line_019a5e2c-7b41-7c3e-9f20-4d8e1a6b5c38" } ``` ## Keep stdin open With `stream=true` and `"open_stdin": true`, the first record carries the `line_id`, and you write input to that line while the command runs. See [Streaming and stdin](/api/streaming) for the full flow.
```json 200 { "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "hello\n", "stderr": "", "refusal": null, "line_id": "line_019a5e2c-7b41-7c3e-9f20-4d8e1a6b5c37" } ```
| Status | Meaning | | --- | --- | | `400` | The request is malformed. The body is not valid JSON, has an unknown or invalid field, or its multipart parts are missing or out of order. Or the options conflict, as `stream` with `explain`, `open_stdin` without `stream=true` or with a stdin part, or `explain` with anything but `command`. | | `401` | The token is missing or wrong | | `404` | The workspace, session, job or file does not exist | | `409` | Another server owns command execution for this workspace. The error detail identifies that server. | | `422` | A query parameter has an invalid value, such as `explain=maybe`. | | `429` | Past a rate limit, or a new session past max_sessions | | `413` | The request body, multipart part, or stdin exceeds its size limit. | | `499` | The running shell job was canceled. | | `500` | The job or server operation failed internally. Inspect detail and server logs before retrying. | | `503` | The server is shutting down and accepts no new commands. | See [error examples and recovery steps](/api/errors). The [complete OpenAPI contract](https://github.com/strukto-ai/mirage/blob/main/docs/openapi.yaml) includes every response schema.
